about: A splitter cuts the task into four parts, one subject each, four workers answer them at the same time and a reducer merges the answers. All run on Cloudflare, free tier.
how: The splitter answers with a list of parts, every part goes to a worker, and the reducer gets all the results.
learns: Map-reduce splits one big task into many small ones that run side by side, then merges the results.
watch: The parts the splitter made, and how the reducer joined the four answers.
